decisions.decision: Supt. Holman will obtain quotes for the cost of rules and regulations signs for both cemeteries.
decisions.quote: supt. holman will get some quotes for the cost.

decisions.decision: The $2,500.00 donation from George Reichard will be placed in a special account to be drawn on for the signs and granite posts.
decisions.quote: the $2,500.00 will be put in a special account so that we may draw from it to have the signs and granite posts purchased.

decisions.decision: The Commission agreed to go ahead with the foundation portion of the new garage on Holman St. rather than wait until spring.
decisions.quote: after much discussion it was decided to go ahead with the foundation portion of the building.

decisions.decision: Placing a newspaper advertisement for the Columbarium in the Fitchburg Sentinel was deferred for the time being.
decisions.quote: there was discussion on placing an add in the fitchburg sentinel for the columbarium. it was decided to wait for the time being.

decisions.decision: Participation in Wreaths Over America was determined not feasible for the Commission.
decisions.quote: with 1,400 veterans it isn't feasible for us to participate.

decisions.decision: Discussion of cemetery rates was passed over until a later time.
decisions.quote: discussion on cemetery rates were passed over until a later time.
